title: Growth Account Executive
description:
About SleekFlow

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth globally thanks to the support of renowned investors like Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund and Tiger Global. Our mission is to develop the next generation of Conversational AI, empowering customer interactions across all channels—from messaging to voice—and enhancing business workflows and processes.


You will have the opportunity to thrive alongside the company through equity options. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and assume a larger role, we look forward to meeting you!


At SleekFlow, we have developed an all-in-one Omnichannel Conversation AI Suite that drives conversions through conversations. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our AI customer engagement platform, enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.


As we expand into the US market, we’re on the lookout for adventurous, diverse, and passionate Brazilian talents to join us on this exciting journey. Become a part of our team and take your career to new heights with SleekFlow!


Associate Level

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Prior Experience in SaaS/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Business-level fluency in English



Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the US market expansion, develop client relationships, and driving US sales growth
  • Actively manage the sales process, including positioning, presentation/demonstration of product, and closing warm leads generated by marketing and sales development
  • Full sales cycle rep, actively managing the sales process, including positioning, presentation/demonstration of product, and closing
  • Managing complex sales cycles and presenting to C-level executives the value of SleekFlow's software

  • Business-level fluency in English is a must (American accent preferred) & Portuguese, Spanish will be a plus
  • Degree in Business or a related field (preferred with USA background)

description:
Job Title: IT Support Engineer (Short-Term Project)

The selected Engineer/Consultant/Technician will be responsible for the deployment and installation of Microsoft IoT sensors at the client site. The scope of work includes:

2. Technician/Consultant/Engineer must wear PPE, including safety glasses, safety shoes, helmet, and earplugs, if required at the site. These will be provided by the End-Customer.

12.Tag and label all installed hardware, power supplies, and wiring as instructed, using provided tags and labels.

15.Verify all network configurations and network traffic. Confidential-Third Party 16.Complete and submit the asset information form, including details such as MAC address, serial number, model, and default credentials for all hardware.

17.Configure management IP to enable remote connectivity for Wipro’s team.

18.Participate in interface meetings with the Wipro/Kenvue team.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.E., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.E., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.


Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation


For more information, you may check our website：


Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.


Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)


Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.


Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

title: Analista De Faturamento Pleno
description:
Principais Atividades:

  • Emitir o faturamento dos prêmios de seguros e cosseguros, realizar o cadastro das apólices conforme documentos, e analisar as rejeições de vendas, a fim de garantir a entrega do faturamento da companhia.
  • Validar e emitir o faturamento das vendas de seguros pelos parceiros, atender os processos e enviar todos os documentos informados no book operacional, e atender o parceiro para dúvidas sobre o faturamento.
  • Realizar a criação e manutenção das apólices via sistema, atendendo a demandas recebidas por ticket, assegurando o cumprimento das regras definidas no documento de implantação (contrato), e do prazo estipulado.
  • Realizar a inclusão de certificados fora da base segundo comprovação para atendimento de sinistro e tratar o problema na causa raiz, com o objetivo de manter a base equalizada.
  • Analisar o relatório de rejeições, entrar em contato com o parceiro e tratar as rejeições de vendas por lojistas não encontrados e/ou produtos não cadastrados de garantia estendida (GE), assegurando a aceitação da rejeição no sistema.
  • Emitir as especificações de cosseguro aceito e cedido de prêmio e restituições, em conformidade com as regras e acordado com as congêneres.


O que te torna ideal para essa vaga:

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Conhecimento solido em seguros;
  • Conhecimento emfaturamento de apólices;
  • Desejável conhecimento em processos;
  • Pacote Office nível intermediário.


A Seguradora para um mundo em mudança


Somos líder mundial em alianças do setor de bancasseguros e seguros de proteção de crédito, com presença em 33 países e posições fortes em três regiões: Europa, Ásia e América Latina. Com mais de 8.000 mil funcionários no mundo todo.


A BNP Paribas Cardif tem um papel essencial na vida dos clientes segurados, fornecendo soluções econômicas que permitem a realização de objetivos com a proteção contra eventos inesperados. Como uma empresa comprometida, a BNP Paribas Cardif se esforça para ter um impacto positivo na sociedade e contribuir para que os seguros sejam acessíveis ao maior número de pessoas possível.


No Brasil, somos uma das maiores especialistas em seguros massificados. Temos um portfólio de produtos diversificado, com destaque para: prestamista, garantia estendida (inclusive veicular), roubo e furto qualificado de portáveis com quebra acidental.


Somos uma seguradora B2B2C, ou seja, temos um modelo de negócio baseado em parcerias, em que nossos seguros são distribuídos para os clientes por meio da rede de grandes empresas brasileiras, divididas nos principais mercados: VAREJO, BANCOS e DIGITAL.


Venha trabalhar com a gente e vamos, juntos, tornar os seguros mais acessíveis à população brasileira!

title: Financial Controller - Latam
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations.
A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable.
Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.
 Additional Information
The Team
You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Especialista De Experiência Do Cliente

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Assistente De Manutenção
description:
Resumo das atividades


Foco em Manutenção Residencial .

  • Executar manutenção corretiva elétrica, mecânica e hidráulica em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, atendendo solicitações internas e de moradores, diagnosticando defeitos, através de manuais, desenhos e/ou avaliação técnica, substituindo peças e efetuando os ajustes necessários;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva (mecânica, elétrica e hidráulica) baseando-se em checklist, inspecionando equipamentos de sistemas de refrigeração, funcionamento de bombas, caixa d’água, parte elétrica, geradores etc., detectando possíveis irregularidades, executando os reparos e informando o superior sobre os problemas detectados;

  • Cuidar da segurança dos usuários, residentes e funcionários, durante a execução dos serviços de manutenção;
  • Prestar suportetécnico aos moradores e demais usuários, realizando manutenção corretiva/preventiva nos apartamentos;
  • Acompanhar leitura e registrar o consumo diário de gás, água e energia;
  • Inspecionar os equipamentos de combate a incêndio;
  • Solicitar e acompanhar visita técnica e manutenção realizada por terceiros;
  • Cumprir procedimentos relativos ao uso de EPI e EPC;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados nos serviços de manutenção, requisitando sua reposição quando necessário;
  • Orientar profissionais de menor nível de experiência assim como fornecedores;
  • Executar pequenos serviços de alvenaria e marcenaria, quando necessário;
  • Registrar as manutenções efetuadas e todos os atendimentos realizados a moradores;
  • Executar outrasatribuições correlatas de acordo com a necessidade da área;
  • Liderar e coordenar equipe de brigadistas, realizar ações de treinamento e procedimentos para o Edifício.
  • Controlar o estoque de materiais, peças, componentes, ferramentas e equipamentos, verificando quantidades e registrando em documentos e planilhas sua movimentação;


Qualificação

Ensino médio completo;

Desejável superior ou técnico em elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, hidráulica;

Curso de NR10.


Habilidades

Capacidade resolutiva;

Comunicar-se de forma inclusiva e eficaz diante um público multicultural e amplamente conectado;

Organização para arquivar informações de maneira correta;

Proatividade em executar as manutenções.

  • Assistência odontológica
  • Vale-refeição
  • Vale-transporte

title: Senior Consultant – Global Transaction Banking
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).


If you are passionate about corporate banking solutions , trade finance , and cash management , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on Global Transaction Banking (GTB) .
  • Drive and support initiatives in:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).
  • Cash Management (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).
  • Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables within defined time and cost parameters .
  • Prepare and deliver project reporting to senior management through presentations and executive updates.
  • Coordinate workshops and meetings with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.
  • Define and execute testing initiatives in collaboration with IT teams.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.
  • Support change management and successful adoption of new systems or processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PIX (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulations (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and international trade finance standards .
  • Proven experience participating in the implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking , or related sectors.
  • Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).
  • Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).
  • Proven skills in requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .
  • Familiarity with corporate banking platforms such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.
  • Experience with digital and API-based GTB solutions .
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Spanish is a strong plus.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.
  • Familiarity with process automation (RPA) and liquidity dashboards (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience in operational and liquidity risk management .
  • Exposure to cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPA-20, CTP, CFA ;
    graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.


Preferred Education

  • Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.
  • Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:
  • Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.
  • MBA focused on strategic management and stakeholder engagement.
  • Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead strategic GTB transformation projects for top-tier financial institutions.
  • Work in a dynamic and international environment with exposure to high-impact banking initiatives.
  • Continuous learning, certifications, and professional development plans .
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • Flexible work model (Hybrid – São Paulo).


CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • VR - R$ 800,00
  • A collaborative work environment, internal events, and global mobility opportunities.


Learn more about us: nfq.Es | LinkedIn NFQ

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)


Ready to lead GTB transformation and make an impact in corporate banking? Apply now!

The SAP AMS Project Manager also drives continuous improvement, governance, and customer satisfaction in a global delivery model.

Service & Project Delivery

Oversee delivery of SAP enhancements, small projects, and rollouts within agreed timelines and budgets.

Ensure SLAs, KPIs, and service quality targets are consistently achieved.

Drive root cause analysis and preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents.


Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary contact for clients regarding SAP AMS delivery.

Facilitate regular status, governance, and steering committee meetings.

Build and maintain strong business stakeholder relationships across Finance, Supply Chain, and other SAP domains.

Translate business priorities into SAP AMS delivery plans.


Team & Vendor Coordination

Allocate resources and track performance of functional and technical consultants.

Collaborate with third-party vendors for specialized SAP services (e.G., Cloud, S/4HANA, integrations).


Governance, Reporting & Financials

Prepare and deliver monthly/quarterly service performance reports.

Track AMS budgets, contract compliance, and cost optimization initiatives.

Identify and escalate risks/issues with mitigation strategies.


Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Recommend SAP process improvements and automation opportunities.

Support migration, upgrades, or transition projects (e.G., ECC to S/4HANA).

Drive adoption of ITIL best practices, Agile, or DevOps in SAP AMS delivery.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field.

7+ years of experience in SAP project/AMS management.

Strong knowledge of SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.) and integration points.

Experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Release Management).

Proven track record in managing global/onshore-offshore delivery models.

Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

PMP, ITIL, or SAP certifications (SAP Solution Manager, Activate, S/4HANA) preferred.


Key Competencies

Deep understanding of SAP AMS operating model.

Strong leadership and team coordination skills.

Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making ability.

Customer-first mindset with service excellence orientation.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - Latam
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

title: Cientista De Dados
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Procuramos Cientista de Dados que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D): Conduzir análises exploratórias complexas e desenvolver modelos preditivos e prescritivos para resolver desafios de negócio, desde a otimização de processos até a criação de novos produtos.

Governança de IA e MLOps: Definir, implantar e operacionalizar a governança para todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Ciência de Dados em ambiente cloud, incluindo a implementação de esteiras de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e versionamento de modelos.

Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, fornecendo suporte a outros cientistas e engenheiros de dados, disseminando conhecimento e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.

Arquitetura de Soluções de Dados: Projetar e documentar a arquitetura de soluções de IA configurando ambientes e ferramentas em cloud (preferencialmente Azure) e produzindo templates e aceleradores para otimizar a entrega de projetos.

Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de negócio para entender suas necessidades, traduzir requisitos em especificações técnicas e apresentar os resultados e o valor gerado pelas soluções de forma clara e executiva.

Inovação Contínua: Avaliar e testar novas tecnologias, frameworks e tendências do mercado de IA (ex: Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural, Análise de dados de IoT) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.


Competências Técnicas :


Linguagens e Ferramentas: Proficiência em Python e/ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.

Machine Learning e Deep Learning: Sólida experiência com bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch e Keras. Conhecimento prático em técnicas de regressão, classificação, clusterização, séries temporais, Text Analytics (NLP) e visão computacional.

Plataformas de Cloud: Experiência hands-on com serviços de IA em nuvem, especialmente Azure Machine Learning. Conhecimento em Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics e/ou serviços equivalentes em AWS ou GCP é um diferencial.

Bancos de Dados e Big Data: Domínio de estruturas de bancos de dados (Relacional e NoSQL), linguagem SQL e experiência com tecnologias de Big Data como Hadoop, Spark ou MapReduce.

MLOps e Governança: Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps para IA (MLOps), incluindo versionamento de código (Git), CI/CD para modelos e monitoramento da performance em produção. Familiaridade com frameworks de governança corporativa de IA.

Visualização de Dados: Habilidade para criar dashboards e relatórios interativos utilizando ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau ou bibliotecas como Matplotlib e Seaborn.


Certificações (Desejável):

Certificação: Apresentar pelo menos uma certificação relevante em cloud ou dados (ex: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate).


Diferenciais :

Experiência com dados de IoT, especialmente em ambientes industriais ou de manufatura.

Conhecimento em mais de uma plataforma de cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Experiência prévia no setor de atuação da empresa (ex: mineração, finanças, varejo).

Contribuições para a comunidade de tecnologia (ex: projetos open-source no GitHub, artigos em blogs, palestras em eventos).

Inglês avançado/fluente para colaboração com times globais.


Formação:

Formação Acadêmica: Formação superior completa nas áreas mencionadas.

Qualificação Avançada: Pós-graduação, MBA ou Mestrado em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou área afim. Certificações de nível Expert ou Specialty (e.G., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty).


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

description:

title: Nelotraders Entusiastas Em Trading E Investimentos - São Paulos/Sp
description:
Se o título da vaga despertou o seu interesse, é bem provável que você já conheça a Nelogica e os nossos produtos, né?


Somos uma investech que atua no desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas de alta performance para o mercado financeiro. Em nosso portfólio, temos produtos que levam acesso à informação em tempo real e disponibilizam ferramentas para análise e negociação tanto na bolsa de valores brasileira (B³), quanto no mercado de criptomoedas e outras bolsas de negociação global. Além disso, temos um extenso portfólio de soluções institucionais que atendem os principais players do mercado de investimentos e somos uma referência no segmento.


Hoje dominamos o mercado de plataformas para trading e com todas as nossas soluções, atingimos +2 milhões de usuários! Por isso, desafios por aqui não faltam e temos muitas oportunidades em aberto, nas mais diversas frentes de atuação com base em São Paulo/SP.


Se você se identifica com o mercado financeiro, já conhece o Profit, Vector, AlgoTools, Comdinheiro ou outro dos nossos produtos, já fez operações de trading ou algo parecido… o que acha de fazer parte do time Nelogica e transformar o futuro do mercado financeiro com a gente? Se inscreva por aqui!


Que tipos de atuação um apaixonado por mercado financeiro pode ter aqui no time? São inúmeras as possibilidades, mas algumas das principais, são:


  • Educacional;
  • Marketing;
  • Relacionamento;
  • Vendas;
  • Backoffice;
  • Atendimento Institucional.


E claro, estamos sempre abrindo novas oportunidades! Nosso time irá analisar a sua candidatura e rolando uma identificação, entraremos em contato para entendermos o seu momento de carreira e avaliarmos posições aderentes.


Consideramos como diferenciais experiências complementares além da atuação profissional, como o envolvimento acadêmico (PETs, mentorias, cursos, competições etc), ou envolvimento em comunidades de sua área de atuação, trabalho voluntário entre outros.

title: Especialista Em Dados
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Administrador de Dados - Especialista que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Modelagem de Dados: Projetar, desenvolver e manter modelos de dados relacionais e multidimensionais para atender a requisitos de sistemas transacionais (OLTP) e analíticos (OLAP/Data Warehouse).

Gestão de Metadados: Administrar o catálogo de dados, definindo conceitos de negócio, mantendo a linhagem da informação (data lineage) e assegurando que os metadados sejam claros e acessíveis.

Qualidade de Dados (Data Quality): Implementar e monitorar regras de qualidade de dados, identificar anomalias e colaborar com as equipes de negócio e desenvolvimento para corrigir inconsistências.

Governança de Dados: Apoiar na criação, curadoria e evolução de guias de boas práticas e padrões para modelagem e integração de dados, garantindo a conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações como a LGPD.

Implementação e Curadoria: Criar e realizar a curadoria dos modelos físicos de dados nos bancos de dados, garantindo que a implementação esteja alinhada ao design lógico.

Colaboração Técnica: Atuar como ponto de referência para equipes de desenvolvimento, BI e ciência de dados, oferecendo suporte e expertise em questões relacionadas à estrutura e acesso aos dados


Competências Técnicas


Domínio avançado e estratégico de práticas de modelagem e arquitetura de dados, incluindo Data Vault e outros padrões modernos.

Experiência profunda e liderança técnica com ferramentas de modelagem (Oracle Data Modeler) e da suíte de governança Informatica (IDMC).

Capacidade de desenhar e implementar estratégias de governança de dados do zero, incluindo a definição de roadmaps e políticas de acordo com a LGPD e outras regulamentações.

Habilidade para atuar como mentor técnico, definindo e disseminando as melhores práticas de modelagem e qualidade de dados para outras equipes.

Sólida experiência com ecossistemas de Big Data e plataformas de dados em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).


Certificações (Desejável)

title: Analista Fiscal Jr
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Analista Fiscal, você irá:


  • Conhecimento sobre fato gerador de impostos indiretos: ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS COFINS;
  • Análise de documentos fiscais: NFe, CTe NFSe;
  • Vivência em apuração de impostos;
  • Conhecimento sobre direito a crédito de impostos;
  • Conhecimento emobrigações acessórias: SPED ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, DIRBI
  • Conhecimento em registro de notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Conhecimento sobre regras de carta de correção;
  • Experiência comsistema integrado, SAP ECC e Tax One será diferencial.


Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:


  • Formação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência comprovada na área fiscal;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Office (Work, PowerPoint e Excel);

- Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo na área Logística, Administrativa ou áreas afins;

- Flexibilidade de horário;

title: Analista Sr - Funds
description:
AVISO: "A TMF Group em nenhum momento solicita qualquer tipo de pagamento como parte do nosso processo seletivo, e sempre contatamos nossos candidatos via contas e plataformas corporativas. Se você foi abordado e com solicitação de pagamento, trata-se de uma fraude. Por favor, verifique se a vaga a qual você está interessado, está publicada em nosso site."


About TMF Group:

A TMF Group é líder no fornecimento de serviços administrativos essenciais, ajudando os clientes a investir e operar com segurança em todo o mundo. Nossos 9.100 especialistas e 120 escritórios em 85 jurisdições em todo o mundo atendem a empresas, instituições financeiras, gerentes de ativos, clientes privados e escritórios familiares, fornecendo a combinação de serviços de contabilidade, impostos, folha de pagamento, administração de fundos, conformidade e gerenciamento de entidades essenciais para o sucesso dos negócios globais.


SOBRE O SEU PERFIL

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com fundos de investimento, preferencialmente FIPs.
  • Conhecimento em operações de câmbio e estruturação de investimentos offshore.
  • Excel avançado e familiaridade com ferramentas de análise financeira.
  • Inglês avançado (desejável para leitura de documentos e comunicação com stakeholders internacionais).
  • Capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e perfil colaborativo.


SOBRE A POSIÇÃO

  • Realizar análise de fundos de Private Equity, Venture Capital e Corporate Venture Capital.
  • Acompanhar e realizar operações de câmbio para investimentos offshore.
  • Executar o controle de liquidez dos fundos , garantindo previsibilidade e alinhamento com os compromissos financeiros.
  • Realizar análise das empresas investidas , incluindo performance, governança e indicadores financeiros.
  • Efetuar o batimento de carteiras e validação de taxas dos fundos.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e apresentações para comitês de investimento.
  • Interagir com áreas internas (jurídico, compliance, contabilidade) e externas (custodiantes, bancos, gestores).
  • Garantir aderência às políticas internas e regulatórias aplicáveis à estrutura dos fundos.


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Modelo Hibrido (até 3 dias no escritório)
  • Vale Transporte (desconto 2,5%)
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Wellhub
  • Previdência Privada
  • Day-off de Aniversário
  • Presente de Nascimento
  • Presente de Casamento
  • Desconto Cinema
  • Quick Massage
  • Serviços de Manicure
  • Ginástica Laboral
  • Parcerias de Educação
  • Ajuda de Custo Home-office
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Plataforma de Idiomas Online
  • Programa de Orientação e Apoio Pessoal
  • Licença Maternidade 180 dias
  • Licença Paternidade 20 dias


O QUE TEMOS

Impacto Internacional

Nossa presença global em mais de 80 países permite que você influencie a maneira como diversos clientes globais fazem negócios, bem como retribuir as comunidades globais em que operamos.

Seja parte do One TMF

Na TMF Group, nosso pessoal é o que nos torna quem somos. Nossa empresa prospera com o espírito empreendedor de pessoas proativas que combinam entusiasmo com responsabilidade e prestação de contas.

Um mundo de oportunidades

Independentemente de onde você esteja em sua carreira, a TMF Group abre um mundo de oportunidades onde você fará parte de nossa equipe e receberá suporte em sua jornada profissional.

Sendo uma instituição com oportunidades iguais, TMF Group visa diversidade buscando contratar e desenvolver profissionais talentosos, independentemente de sua idade, raça, etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, religião e educação. Acreditamos que as diferentes historias, origens, e experiências multiculturais de nossos colaboradores são um poderoso elemento para a criação de um ambiente inclusivo e diversificado onde todos se sintam à vontade em demonstrar sua personalidade única e autentica no trabalho. Trabalhamos fortemente para conseguir criar um ambiente de trabalho que reflita as comunidades que servimos e perspectivas únicas que nossa diversa equipe traz para a nossa companhia e clientes.

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!


About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.


Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.



Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient


Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.


A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

Você é uma pessoa organizada, daquelas que não suporta uma mesa de trabalho bagunçada?

Buscamos uma pessoa que queira crescer aprendendo na prática sobre gestão, atendimento, finanças e sobre a nossa operação.

Aqui, o aprendizado é constante para estarmos sempre acima da média do mercado e cada desafio traz a oportunidade de desenvolver competências que farão diferença em toda a sua carreira.

Você atuará diretamente com a diretoria , participando do dia a dia da operação e contribuindo para o bom andamento dos projetos e da rotina do escritório.

title: Global Pm Practice – Senior Pm Ra And Fraud
description:
As a trusted partner to over 1,000 Communications Service Providers (CSPs) across 180+ countries, Mobileum empowers telcos to thrive in a world of constant disruption. We deliver the insights, automation, and actionable intelligence needed to monetize innovation, safeguard networks, and elevate customer experience.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley with a global footprint spanning Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and the Americas, Mobileum operates at the intersection of connectivity, intelligence, and growth.

The Mobileum Global Project Management Team consists of Project Managers who deliver the contracted scope of work to our customers.


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex IT projects in the telecommunications sector. This role will manage end-to-end delivery of revenue assurance and/or fraud-prevention software solutions for major telecom operators across Brazil and Latin America.


Key Responsibilities / Functions

  • Plan, lead, and deliver multiple concurrent projects , ensuring completion on time, within budget, and to the expected quality standards.
  • Oversee project financial milestones , including billing control, cost management, and revenue recognition.
  • Lead and inspire multicultural implementation teams across different countries and time zones as part of a matrix-based organization.
  • Prepare and deliver operational and executive status presentations to stakeholders and customers.
  • Supervise implementation teams, proactively managing risks and issue resolution.
  • Support sales activities by reviewing and validating technical proposals and SOWs , providing effort estimates, and creating deployment schedules.
  • Ensure adherence to recognized IT project management methodologies and best practices .


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business (major in Computing) or applicable Industry experience
  • Minimum 10 years´ experience in hands on IT project management , including complex, long-duration projects (10+ people, 1+ year duration).
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in delivering Telco-related Enterprise Software solutions , preferably with strong knowledge of BSS/OSS architecture
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience creating and managing project budgets and managing project profitability
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience scoping, forecasting, issue and risk management.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing multiple projects with proven experience managing distributed teams in remote, multicultural environments Matrix Organization .
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools such as MS Project (or similar).
  • PMP certification or at least in-depth knowledge of PMP Methodology is highly desirable.


Desired Competencies & Soft Skills

  • Proven experience in working within a 100% Matrix based organization
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience working directly with both business and technical stakeholders
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership
  • Hands on Personality by showing and demonstrating to the team.
  • Strong organizational skills with the capacity to manage multiple projects in parallel.
  • Financial acumen to manage budgets, costs, and revenue recognition.
  • Problem-solving mindset, adaptability, and a track record of delivering high-quality results.
  • Language: for this role fluent Portuguese and English are required
  • Travel: up to 50% travel

title: Pessoa Bdr - Sênior
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia em rápido crescimento que transforma a análise de dados financeiros. Nossa plataforma automatiza processos financeiros, contábeis e fiscais, utilizando inteligência artificial para simplificar a integração e a transformação de dados de forma acessível e no-code.

Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa BDR sênior para fortalecer ainda mais nossas soluções!

Como BDR Sênior, você será peça-chave no nosso time Comercial. Seu foco será a prospecção ativa de grandes contas (Enterprise e Large Enterprise) com ciclos de venda longos e complexos, utilizando AI, multicanalidade, inteligência de dados e tecnologia para elevar a qualidade das interações e gerar oportunidades altamente qualificadas.

Além disso, esperamos que você mentore o time, lidere boas práticas e seja parte da evolução constante dos nossos processos com o uso de AI e automações.

O que você vai fazer?

  • Identificar, qualificar e prospectar leads alinhados com nossa estratégia Enterprise;
  • Utilizar Hubspot, Apollo, LinkedIn e outras ferramentas de prospecção como extensão natural do seu trabalho diário;
  • Aplicar frameworks avançados como GPCTBA C&I e dominar diferenciais como MEDDPIC, Command of the Message e Winning By Design;
  • Agendar reuniões estratégicas com alto valor para os executivos e especialistas;
  • Otimizar constantemente os fluxos de automação (vivência com n8n, Clay ou similares é diferencial);
  • Colaborar com nosso BDR AI (já em operação), buscando o futuro da prospecção assistida por inteligência artificial;
  • Manter e garantir a qualidade dos dados no CRM, apoiando as melhores práticas do time;
  • Atuar como mentor em treinamentos, trocas e desenvolvimento interno do time de vendas

que esperamos de você?

  • 5+ anos de experiência em BDR/SDR/Outbound Sales, com atuação relevante em SaaS B2B Enterprise;
  • Domínio práticode Hubspot, Apollo e LinkedIn para campanhas outbound;
  • Vivência ou abertura para uso de IA na prospecção ativa e ferramentas como n8n, Clay, Zapier ou similares;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e espírito de melhoria contínua, com apetite por experimentar novas abordagens;
  • Capacidade de mentorar, liderar iniciativas de melhoria de processo e atuar com ownership no dia a dia;
  • Conhecimento emmetodologias como MEDDPIC, Command of the Message e Winning By Design (diferencial);
  • Habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita em alto nível, tanto com clientes quanto internamente;
  • Alta organização, proatividade e foco em resultados.

O que oferecemos?

  • Modelo híbrido (2x por semana na Av. Paulista)
  • Convênio com TotalPass para atividades físicas
  • Flash com benefícios flexíveis
  • Seguro de vida
  • Assistência médica pela SulAmérica e assistência odontológica pela Careplus
  • Auxílio creche
  • Auxílio para home office
  • Day off no mês de aniversário
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento por meio de parcerias educacionais com OpenEnglish , PUCRS e FIAP .
  • Ambiente colaborativo e apoio ao bem-estar dos colaboradores.

Na Dattos, acreditamos que sucesso é mais do que satisfação — é sobre crescer juntos, transformar desafios em oportunidades e impactar o futuro das finanças com tecnologia e inovação. Se você compartilha desse mindset e busca um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo, essa é a sua chance.
